name: Pamela Ford
office: Antelope Valley Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Pamela Ford listed her 2026 occupation as classified union president and signed a 2016 labor agreement as president of the Antelope Valley College Federation of Classified Employees. A state labor board decision noted she became a classified employee of the district in 1996. She has participated in shared governance and collective bargaining at Antelope Valley College. She signed a 2026 layoff agreement as union president.
